title: The best assistant I have ever used.
body:
I have been trying to find an app to remind me of my other obligations but failed a couple of times.

Then I number into this app and it keeps on reminding me of every task I'm ought to do, how it does the job makes sure that I get the message.

It has helped me complete more of my goals in the 2 weeks I have spent with it on my phone. 

Task by Google is a great reminder.

title: Imports Reminders From Calendar 🙂
body: Another great job, I especially love the ability to import reminders from google calendar. I don’t think it is fair that this app has a low rating, it is solid, and I don’t believe the haters have any idea just how much work is being done behind the scenes. Apps are not small projects to kick off and they are allot of work to maintain as well - you should be happy that this is offered for FREE!
